verdict.rationale: Canny's Autopilot extracts feature requests from unstructured conversations and transcripts. Its MCP server lets an external LLM such as Claude or ChatGPT draft PRDs from real requests and run agents that act on feedback, so feedback can be turned into task-like output. However, the breakdown into proposed tasks is done by a third-party LLM, not a native Canny feature, and the Jira/Linear/Asana integrations only push or link feedback rather than having AI generate a task set. Missing for 10: a native AI feature that converts a plain-language description into structured proposed tasks, documentation of the task output format, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
